meta.description: Campaign schedule as mechanics only. Months list objectives and setup values. Unlocks list every rule, action, component and deck change in the order a typical campaign meets them. Region recons can happen earlier than listed. Each region also has a forced deadline, given in its trigger.

campaignRules.monthAttempts: Each month allows up to two games. Win: advance to the next month and lower rationing by 2. Lose the first game: replay the month and raise rationing by 2. Lose the second game: raise rationing by 2 and advance anyway. Applies to December too.
campaignRules.rationing: Rationing level starts at 4 (prologue and January). Range 0 to 10. It is the number of Rationed Event cards the group picks from the reserve for the Player deck.
campaignRules.objectiveProgress: Objective progress resets between games unless the objective card says it carries over (Get Hollow Men to defect; The Plan checkboxes). Objectives persist month to month until a card destroys them.
campaignRules.legacyDeckFlow: At setup, read Legacy cards until a PAUSE or STOP card. PAUSE: resume at game end (step 2). STOP: resume at the next month's setup. Cards are never returned, even on a replayed month.
campaignRules.regionDeadlines: Each month opens with a Perimeter Report. If the named region door is unopened, the region is opened for the players. Its contents apply, but it completes no objective, and its reward Unrationed Event card is destroyed.

productionUnitsByCitiesOnGrid.note: Bracket bounds read from a board photo. Unit values are not legible in any source, so they are inferred from reported totals in two play reports. Only connected, non-forsaken cities count. Havens do not count.

infectionRateTrack.note: Marker starts on the leftmost 2. The rulebook says the rate caps at 5. The number of spaces between is read from a photo and not confirmed.

incidentTrack.note: The game is lost when the marker reaches the last (skull) space. One player report describes losing at the 8th incident.

objectives.rule: Build 3 supply centers during this game. Permanent supply centers placed at setup do not count. Any colors.
Do the Recon action at Washington (supply center there, discard any 3 blue City cards).

setupChanges: Destroy the prologue objective card.
Stockpile 36 Supply cubes.
Rationing level 4.
No turning points yet.

objectives.rule: Complete any one Recon action that opens a new region.
Connect 2 cities to the grid during this game by supply line or sea lane. Cities added by a Legacy card or a printed sticker line do not count.

setupChanges: Destroy the Recon North America objective.
Stockpile 33 Supply cubes.
Perimeter Report: if door 66 is unopened, open Package 1 for the players and destroy its Unrationed Event.

objectives.rule: Do the Search action twice during this game (two scratch boxes; may be the same card).
Move a pawn into a lost haven (not one of the three starting havens).

setupChanges: Stockpile 30 Supply cubes.
Perimeter Report for door 67 (South America) is a warning only; nothing is forced this month.
Stockpile 27 Supply cubes.
Stretched Too Thin now sets the Epidemic count.
Perimeter Report: if South America is unopened, open Package 5 for the players.
Stockpile 24 Supply cubes.
Perimeter Report checks door 60 (the eastern Pacific lost haven); what it forces was not recorded.
Stockpile 21 Supply cubes.
No new rules; story cards only.

objectives.rule: Have satellite towers in a blue city, a yellow city and a black city at the same time. Permanent towers count. On completion open door 35 and destroy this objective.

setupChanges: Stockpile 18 Supply cubes.
Perimeter Report: if door 57 (Africa) is unopened, open Package 7 for the players and destroy its Unrationed Event.

objectives.rule: As July, if not yet completed.

setupChanges: Stockpile 15 Supply cubes.
Perimeter Report: if door 62 (Middle East) is unopened, open Package 2 for the players and destroy its Unrationed Event.
Monitor action and Frequency Scanner arrive.
One free character upgrade: spend up to 2 production units on abilities at once.

objectives.rule: Do the Recon action at Kolkata that opens Package 3. Completion carries over to the second game of the month.

setupChanges: Stockpile 12 Supply cubes.
Destroy Recon 1 Unknown Region; add Recon East Asia (mandatory).
Perimeter Report: if door 65 (Indian Ocean lost haven) is unopened, it is opened for the players.
Inoculated cards in Package 6 return through Epidemics (rule sticker R).
Setup infection now places Hollow Men on the last 3 of 9 cards (rule sticker D).
New loss condition: running out of Hollow Men figures.

objectives.rule: At least 1 Hollow Men figure on each of 3 different havens. If completed in the first game of October but that game is lost, it counts as complete in the second game.

setupChanges: Stockpile 8 Supply cubes.
Destroy Recon East Asia, Connect 2 New Cities and Complete 2 Searches.
Perimeter Report: if doors 56 and 63 (East Asia) are unopened, open Package 3 for the players, add a scar to one chosen character, and destroy its Unrationed Event.
Add Turning Point #3 to the Game End area.

objectives.rule: Check all four boxes of The Plan by doing the Recon action in Shanghai four times. No supply center is needed. Each recon discards one set: 5 red City cards of different cities, 4 black of different cities, 3 yellow of different cities, 3 blue of different cities. Checked boxes carry over to later games.

setupChanges: Stockpile 4 Supply cubes.
Destroy Build 3 Supply Centers and Get Hollow Men to Defect.
Destroy An Incomplete Plan; The Plan replaces it.

objectives.rule: Complete when a character carrying the sample is in Johannesburg and Johannesburg has a supply center. Completing it wins the game.

setupChanges: Stockpile 0 Supply cubes (bonuses from lost havens, labs and events still apply).
Destroy The Plan.
If Package 8 is still sealed, open it for the players: Utopia joins the grid, its 8 Infection cards go to the Infection discard pile, and its event card reward is lost.

trigger.detail: Prologue and January setup. Base rules from the printed rulebook.

adds: Board: 9 cities (population 3 each) and 3 havens (population 3 each, players name them). All are ports. Sea lanes are printed between them.
Decks: 36 City cards (4 per starting city), 27 Infection cards (3 per starting city), 8 Produce Supplies cards, 5 Epidemic cards, 4 Rationed Events at start.
Turn: check exposure (start turn on a Plague cube: gain 1 exposure), 4 actions, draw 2 Player cards, infect at the infection rate.

Infect: remove 1 Supply cube from the city. If it has none, place a Plague cube and advance the Incident marker 1. If it would get a 4th Plague cube, outbreak instead: each adjacent location loses 1 Supply cube or gains 1 Plague cube (incident each). Chain outbreaks never place a cube where an outbreak already happened this card.
Epidemic: increase the infection rate; draw the bottom Infection card and remove all Supply cubes there (no Plague cube); shuffle only the discard pile onto the deck.

Actions: Drive/Ferry (1 step along any line), Sail (discard the destination's City card; both ports; needs a sea route), Charter Boat (discard your city's card; to any port on a sea route), Make Supplies (stockpile to your character), Produce Supplies (discard a Produce Supplies card at a haven or supply center: Local fills this location to its population; System-Wide fills every haven and supply center to population and checks a box, destroy the card when all boxes are checked), Deliver Supplies (character to location), Share Knowledge (give or take the City card of the city you share), Build Supply Center (discard 5 cards of the city's color; max 9; move one if none left), Recon (after the January deck reveals it).
Free actions: Pick Up Supplies, Transfer Supplies (same location). Only during your own action step.
Exposure track: 7 scratch boxes per character. A scar box adds a scar sticker. A skull box kills the character permanently.
Game end: lose at the last incident space or when you cannot draw 2 Player cards. Steps: population (plague: -1; supply center: +1; both cancel), Legacy deck, Game End cards, production units.

Production units buy: character abilities, City card improvements (Foundations: counts as 2 cards of its color for Build Supply Center; Infrastructure: counts as 3), Infection card improvements (Well Stocked: no removal if the city has 2 or more cubes; Lockdown: discard from the Infection discard pile to destroy it), population +1 per unit.

trigger.detail: January setup, Legacy deck.

adds: Objectives: Build 3 Supply Centers (mandatory) and Recon North America. 2 required.

Recon action becomes usable: at a printed recon spot, usually with a supply center there, discard the shown cards in one action and open the shown package. Star icons mean any cards of that color; letters mean different cities of that color.

trigger.detail: Recon North America from Washington (any 3 blue). Forced at the start of February if not done.

adds: Map sticker: Chicago, San Francisco, Denver, Atlanta, Los Angeles, Mexico City. Chicago connected at once by a printed line.
New City and Infection cards for those cities go to the reserve until each city connects.
Connecting a city during play: its City cards go to the Player discard pile and its Infection cards to the Game End area (they join the Infection deck after the game).

Action Establish Supply Line (rule sticker J): spend 2 Supply cubes from your character to draw a straight line from your city to another city. It may not cross water, unexplored area, another city or another supply line, and may not end at a haven. Sail and Charter Boat cannot use supply lines.

Action Search (rule sticker L): in the city matching a City card in your hand, scratch one search box on that card and resolve it. Some cards have a land box and a sea box. A companion found by search is permanent; any other result applies once.
Unrationed Event to the recon player: remove all Plague cubes from one location on the grid. Destroyed if the region was forced open.

trigger.detail: End of a January game, Legacy deck at game end.

adds: 4 new Rationed Event cards to the reserve.

trigger.detail: February setup.

adds: Objectives Recon 1 Unknown Region and Connect 2 New Cities (both optional). Still 2 required.

trigger.detail: End of the February game(s), Legacy deck at game end.

adds: Game end upgrade: Permanent Supply Center sticker, 3 production units, limited stickers. Place it next to a city that had a supply center in the just-played game. During setup, each such city starts with a supply center. Permanent supply centers do not count for Build 3 Supply Centers.
3 new Rationed Event cards to the reserve.
Turning Point #1 to the Game End area: when any city reaches population 0, open door 50.

trigger.detail: Turning Point #1 resolves the first time a city is at population 0 at game end.

unlocks.source: Door 50; rule sticker A; board sticker on area 12
adds: Forsaken cities (population 0): only Drive/Ferry is allowed there, no free actions. Its Infection card, whenever drawn, goes to the Game End area and a replacement is drawn. It does not count toward production units. Restoring it to population 1 costs 2 production units.
Infested: every forsaken city gets a permanent infested marker. A character who starts a turn in an infested city is exposed, even after the population is restored.
Havens can drop to 0 population but never become forsaken.

trigger.detail: March setup.

adds: Objectives required rises to 3.
Objectives Complete 2 Searches and Access a Lost Haven (both optional).

trigger.detail: Recon South America from Sao Paulo (any 4 yellow). Forced at the start of April if not done.

unlocks.source: Package 5; doors 67, 23, 39 (and J, L if not yet opened)
adds: Map sticker: Bogota, Lima, Santiago, Buenos Aires. Buenos Aires connected at once.
Recon report pointing to lost labs in the south. Buenos Aires search leads to the Opal lab.
A printed sea route from Lima to the eastern Pacific lost haven.
Unrationed Event to the recon player: move Supply cubes from the reserve into the stockpile (one play report used it for 9 cubes).

trigger.detail: End of the March game(s).

adds: Action Chart Sea Lane (rule sticker K): at a port, spend 2 Supply cubes to draw a sea lane to another port. It may curve, but may not cross land, unexplored area or another sea lane, and may cross at most one red region line. Connecting a city moves its cards as for supply lines.
Setup step 5 Stretched Too Thin (rule sticker E): count City cards in the Player deck. Up to 36: 5 Epidemics; 37-44: 6; 45-51: 7; 52-57: 8; 58-62: 9; 63 or more: 10. Make that many piles in step 7.
New scars.

trigger.detail: Sea search on Los Angeles or San Francisco (or reaching it via Lima): the eastern Pacific lost haven. First pawn to enter names it and opens its door (60 per one source).

adds: Haven added to the grid as a production site.
Per one report, a +15 Supply cube bonus to the stockpile at every setup from then on.

trigger.detail: Land search on the Buenos Aires City card finds the Opal lab.

adds: Free action Inoculate: in your city, take one Player or Infection card of that city from its discard pile and put it into Package 6 (out of play). Package 6 holds at most 30 Player and 30 Infection cards. Hollow Men Gather cards may not go there.
Hidden supply cache sticker: +15 Supply cubes to the stockpile at once and at every later setup.
3 copies of a Rationed Event: when doing Make Supplies, discard it to take 3 more Supply cubes onto your character.
A new character whose Make Supplies takes cubes from the reserve instead of the stockpile.
Lab coordinates card pointing at Lake Baikal and the other labs.
Lab marker for scoring (25 points per lab on the board).

trigger.detail: End of April.

adds: New Infection card improvements available to buy.

trigger.detail: Recon Europe from London (4 different blue cities). No forced date was recorded.

adds: Map sticker: Paris, Frankfurt, St. Petersburg, Moscow. Paris connected at once.
Action Shuttle Flight: move from a haven or supply center on the grid to any other haven or supply center on the grid.
Unrationed Event to the recon player. Its effect is not legible in any source.

trigger.detail: End of May.

adds: New character ability stickers.
More Permanent Supply Center stickers.

trigger.detail: End of June.

adds: 2 new job stickers for creating new characters.
2 new Rationed Event cards.

trigger.detail: Recon Africa from Lagos (5 different yellow cities). Forced at the start of July if not done.

adds: Map sticker: Kinshasa, Khartoum, Dar es Salaam, Antananarivo, Johannesburg. Kinshasa connected at once. Kinshasa, Khartoum and Dar es Salaam are printed infested.
6 satellite tower pieces.
Action Build Satellite Tower (rule sticker O): spend 2 Supply cubes from your character to place a tower in your city; move one if none are left.
Action Transmit: at a city with a satellite tower, give 1 card matching that city's color to any player anywhere.
Game end upgrade: Permanent Satellite Tower, 3 production units.
Unrationed Event to the recon player (destroyed if forced).

trigger.detail: July setup.

adds: Objective Triangulate Signals (optional).

trigger.detail: Triangulate Signals completed.

adds: Hint naming three scanner frequencies worth monitoring (9.2, 9.31, 11.88). The objective is destroyed.

trigger.detail: Recon the Middle East from Cairo (4 different black cities). Forced at the start of August if not done.

adds: Map sticker: Baghdad, Riyadh, Tehran, Delhi, New Mumbai, Kolkata. Baghdad connected at once. Baghdad, Delhi, New Mumbai and Kolkata are printed infested.
4 Hollow Men Gather cards into the Infection discard pile, and Hollow Men figures.

Hollow Men Gather (rule sticker S): when drawn, keep drawing until an Infection card with a city; put exactly 1 Hollow Men figure there instead of infecting it. No cube removed, no Plague cube, no incident, improvements do not apply. If the city already has 3 figures, reduce its population by 1 instead.
Rule sticker T: Gather cards do not count toward the infection rate. A Gather card drawn as the bottom card of an Epidemic is discarded without effect.
Exposure (rule sticker G): a character is exposed whenever its pawn leaves a location with 1 or more Hollow Men, by any means. Sail and Charter Boat do not enter or leave intermediate ports.
Population (rule sticker W, game end step c): a location with 1 or more Hollow Men loses 1 population; Plague and Hollow Men together still lose only 1.
Setup (rule sticker C): put all Hollow Men Gather cards into the Infection discard pile at setup, so they enter the deck at the first Epidemic.
Unrationed Event to the recon player (destroyed if forced).

trigger.detail: August setup.

adds: Action Monitor (rule sticker M): at a city with a satellite tower, draw the top 4 Player cards. Do not resolve Epidemics. Discard all 4 in any order. Scratch 1 Frequency Scanner box and resolve it. When all boxes are scratched, Monitor is gone.

Frequency Scanner card: 10 boxes (8.24, 8.81, 9.1, 9.2, 9.31, 9.58, 9.75, 10.31, 10.57, 11.88). Each box reveals a dossier door to open, or take 1 or 2 cards from the top of the Player discard pile into your hand (never Epidemics). One box opens door 52: the Kolkata recon spot sticker.
One-time: spend up to 2 production units on character abilities immediately.

trigger.detail: End of August.

adds: New scars.
New character abilities.

trigger.detail: Search Johannesburg finds the Jade lab.

adds: A new character who can, once per turn as a free action, destroy the Infection card in the discard pile that matches their city.
Epidemic Infect step removes only 1 Supply cube instead of all (one report). Lab counts for scoring.

trigger.detail: September setup.

unlocks.source: Legacy cards 09-xxx; rule stickers R, D, U
adds: Objective Recon East Asia (mandatory).

Epidemic Infect step (rule sticker R, also a sticker on each Epidemic card): draw a random Infection card from Package 6 instead of the bottom card, remove all Supply cubes from that city, then put the card in the Infection discard pile so it rejoins the deck at Intensify. If Package 6 has no Infection cards, use the bottom card as before.
Setup step 4 (rule sticker D): flip 9 Infection cards, skipping forsaken cities. Resolve the first 6 normally. On the last 3, place a Hollow Men figure instead.
Loss condition (rule sticker U): you lose if you must place a Hollow Men figure and none are left.

trigger.detail: Reaching the Indian Ocean lost haven (charted from Dar es Salaam, New Mumbai or Antananarivo). Forced at the start of September if door 65 is unopened.

adds: Haven added to the grid.
+15 Supply cubes to the stockpile at once and at every later setup.

trigger.detail: Legacy deck in September (one report ties it to Khartoum going forsaken).

adds: Rationed Event: the current player draws the top 4 Player cards, keeps all City cards and discards the rest, Epidemics included without effect.

trigger.detail: Recon East Asia from Kolkata (black cards of different cities). Forced at the start of October if not done.

adds: Map stickers: Bangkok, Ho Chi Minh City, Manila, Jakarta, Seoul, Tokyo, Osaka, Shanghai, Hong Kong. Jakarta connected at once. Manila, Tokyo, Osaka and Shanghai are printed infested. Utopia is shown behind a wall and cannot be accessed until the Hollow Men defect.
Recon spot at Jakarta: supply center there, discard any 2 red cards, open door 59.
4 more Hollow Men Gather cards into the Infection discard pile.

Action Build Shelter (rule sticker N): discard a card of your city's color to place a shelter there (move one if none are left). Characters in a city with a shelter, or leaving it, are never exposed. A city with a shelter loses no population at game end and does not lose population for a 4th Hollow Man.
Rule sticker V (game end step a): skip population loss steps b and c for cities with a shelter.
New Infection card improvements.
An Incomplete Plan card (kept in the reserve).
Unrationed Event to the recon player: place up to 3 shelters for free (destroyed if forced).

trigger.detail: October setup.

adds: Objective Get Hollow Men to Defect (mandatory, carries over to the second October game). 2 required.

Action Broadcast Misinformation (rule sticker P): at a city with a satellite tower, move a Hollow Men figure to a location adjacent to it. Your city's color must match the color of the figure's city. You may not move a figure into a location that already has 3.
Turning Point #3 to the Game End area: if at least 1 Hollow Men figure is on 3 different havens at game end, open door 17 and destroy the turning point.
Game end upgrade: Permanent Shelter, 2 production units each (5 stickers). During setup, place a shelter in each marked city.

trigger.detail: Hollow Men defect (Turning Point #3).

adds: Board sticker opening a gap in the wall: Utopia becomes reachable once The Plan is executed (Package 8).
A character ability that removes Hollow Men figures.

trigger.detail: Turning Point #2: four games lost in a row.

adds: Bonus Supply cubes added to the stockpile for the next few games (one report: 10 per game).

trigger.detail: Recon from Jakarta (any 2 red at a supply center).

adds: Ruined Coral Sea haven placed on the board and joined to the grid by sea lane from Jakarta. The haven has its own recon spot (red cards) leading to New Zealand.

trigger.detail: Recon from the Coral Sea haven with red cards.

adds: Wellington added to the map and grid. It holds the Topaz lab.

Topaz ability: when an Infection card would remove a Supply cube from a city, any player may discard a City card of that city's color to prevent the removal (also during an Epidemic). Not usable if the city has no cube.
A new character whose ability places a shelter in their location.
Lab tracking stickers for scoring.

trigger.detail: November setup.

adds: Objective Complete the Plan (mandatory, only objective, progress carries over).

The Plan card: four Shanghai recons without a supply center: 5 different red, 4 different black, 3 different yellow, 3 different blue. When all four boxes are checked, open Package 8 and destroy the card.

trigger.detail: The Plan completed (or Package 8 forced at December setup).

adds: Utopia joins the grid (population 8, printed infested).
8 Utopia Infection cards: shuffled into the Infection deck if earned, put in the Infection discard pile if forced.
Event card reward (lost if forced). Sources disagree on whether it is rationed or unrationed.

trigger.detail: December setup.

adds: Objective Deliver the Sample (mandatory, only objective).

Action Self-Infect: while in the Pearl lab at Lake Baikal, scratch exposure boxes until a scar or skull appears. On a skull the character dies. On a scar, add the Carrier scar instead of a normal scar. The Carrier scar covers 2 slots and should not cover another scar.
Carrier scar: the pawn moves only by Drive/Ferry; to enter a city it must discard a card of that city's color; at game end, win or lose, the character is destroyed (dies).
Lake Baikal becomes connectable to the grid by supply line from Utopia.

trigger.detail: End of December, win or lose; Legacy deck branches on whether the sample was delivered.

adds: Final scoring (see campaignEnd).

campaignEnd.finalObjective: Deliver the Sample: a character who self-infected at the Pearl lab (Lake Baikal) is in Johannesburg while Johannesburg has a supply center.
campaignEnd.scoring: Games won: 50 points per game won in the first half of a month, 30 per game won in the second half. Population: + the total population of all locations on the grid. Bonuses: +100 for delivering the sample, +25 for each lab marker on the board. Subtotal = games won + population + bonuses. Penalties: -5 for each forsaken city on the grid. Grand total = subtotal - penalties.
